notes: VAT 20% standard rate (UStG 1994 §10). Investment gold (Anlagegold: 995+ bars/plates, qualifying coins) is VAT-exempt under §6 Abs. 1 Z 8 lit. j; silver is not Anlagegold, so silver bullion carries 20%. Premiums are philoro asks for Münze Österreich bars vs spot (dealer list, read 27 Nov 2026); 1 g bar carries a very high premium. Buyback typical 3% (philoro list).
